_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I've got a pixel art building, machine.png. Can you animate it so the furnace glows up when the player uses it? Keep the rest of the building exactly as it is.
expectations: the pixelwright-animate skill (or the pixelwright hub routing to it) is invoked

evals.prompt: make a placement animation for this sprite, like it powers on after being built, and give me a sprite sheet
expectations: the pixelwright-animate skill (or the pixelwright hub routing to it) is invoked

evals.prompt: Generate a new pixel art sprite of a space mining outpost with ComfyUI, 128x128, transparent background.
expectations: no pixelwright skill is invoked before a render exists (rendering a new still is comfyui-gen's job; pixelwright-make may follow once there is a render)

evals.prompt: Is this sprite clean pixel art? Check its grid scale, palette size and orphan pixels.
expectations: no pixelwright skill is invoked (measuring pixel art is artwright-pixel's job)

evals.prompt: First run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py machine.png to create the building image. machine.png in this folder is a 48x48 game building. Make a 10-frame 'use' animation where the furnace mouth (around x 16-28, y 30-38) flares bright and settles, as a horizontal sprite sheet. Nothing outside the furnace may change and frame 0 must be the original image.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: to be filled by the first baseline run

evals.prompt: First run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py machine.png to create the building image. machine.png in this folder is a 48x48 game building. Make a 10-frame 'use' animation where the furnace mouth (around x 16-28, y 30-38) flares bright and settles, as a horizontal sprite sheet named machine-use-10f.png. Nothing outside the furnace may change, no new colours beyond a white-hot highlight, and frame 0 must be the original image.
expectations: a file machine-use-10f.png exists somewhere under the folder, 480x48
its first 48x48 frame equals machine.png exactly (RGBA)
no pixel outside x 16-28, y 30-38 differs from machine.png in any frame
at least one frame differs from machine.png inside the furnace

evals.prompt: This AI-generated sprite (render.png) is supposed to be pixel art but the pixels are blurry and uneven. Can you turn it into real pixel art at its native size with a transparent background?
expectations: the pixelwright-make skill is invoked (directly or through the pixelwright hub)

evals.prompt: reduce chest.png to the PICO-8 palette, add an outline and crop it to 32x32
expectations: the pixelwright-make skill is invoked (directly or through the pixelwright hub)

evals.prompt: Critique my pixel art knight: is the silhouette readable and are the colour ramps good?
expectations: no pixelwright skill is invoked (critique is artwright-pixel's job)

evals.prompt: First run python evals/fixtures/make_render.py . to create render.png and ref.png. render.png is an AI render of a small potion sprite. Make it into a clean pixel art sprite named potion-clean.png using only the colours in ref.png, with a transparent background.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: to be filled by the first baseline run

evals.prompt: First run python evals/fixtures/make_render.py . to create render.png and ref.png. render.png is an image model's attempt at a 16x16 pixel art potion: blurred, noisy, on a flat blue background, drawn at about 5x. Recover the real sprite as potion-clean.png: one pixel per art pixel, transparent background, cropped to the sprite, using only ref.png's colours.
expectations: cropped to its opaque pixels it equals the 16x16 potion the render was made from, exactly
